card.name: The word other before co-given drugs
card.fires_on: The word "other" (or "another") right after phrases like "concomitant use of" or "combination with", just before a drug class such as QT-prolonging drugs or antiarrhythmics. Also "itant" inside "Concomitant" in an interaction heading.

modes.label: other before drugs
modes.description: "other" or "another" after concomitant use, treatment with, or taking, introducing a second drug group.
